intake_body: Build an executive brief from evidence, separate facts from recommendations, preserve claim provenance, and produce decision-ready next steps with confidence and caveats.
query_spec: Q4 platform investment recommendations with risk and confidence

factual_claims.text: Platform A processed 12.5M transactions in Q3 with 99.94% uptime
Customer churn for cohorts using Platform A is 3.2% lower than baseline
Platform A's marginal cost per transaction is $0.018

recommendations.text: Increase Platform A capacity by 40% before Q1 to meet projected demand
Begin migration of Platform B workloads to Platform A starting Q1

caveats.text: Platform A capacity expansion requires hardware procurement lead-time of 8-12 weeks
Migration costs not yet quantified — REC-002 confidence is provisional
